CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State" (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  ghl_contact_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  campaign_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''enrolled'',
  current_step INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_template_key TEXT,
  last_sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  provider_message_id TEXT,
  phone_at_send TEXT,
  stop_reason TEXT,
  reply_status TEXT,
  last_inbound_message_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  last_delivery_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  delivery_status TEXT,
  opt_out_status TEXT,
  slack_notified_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  run_id TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE (ghl_contact_id, campaign_key)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "SimpleTexting_Campaign_Event_Log" (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  ghl_contact_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  campaign_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  step_number INT,
  template_key TEXT,
  provider_message_id TEXT,
  details JSONB,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
ALTER TABLE "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reply_status TEXT;
ALTER TABLE "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_inbound_message_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
ALTER TABLE "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_delivery_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
ALTER TABLE "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS delivery_status TEXT;
ALTER TABLE "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS opt_out_status TEXT;
ALTER TABLE "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS slack_notified_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
WITH upsert_state AS (
  INSERT INTO "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State" (
    ghl_contact_id, campaign_key, status, current_step, last_template_key, last_sent_at,
    provider_message_id, phone_at_send, stop_reason, reply_status,
    last_inbound_message_at, last_delivery_at, delivery_status, opt_out_status, slack_notified_at,
    run_id, updated_at
  ) VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, $4, $5,
    NOW(), NULL, NULL, $6, NOW(), $7, NOW()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (ghl_contact_id, campaign_key)
  DO UPDATE SET
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    reply_status = EXCLUDED.reply_status,
    last_inbound_message_at = EXCLUDED.last_inbound_message_at,
    opt_out_status = EXCLUDED.opt_out_status,
    slack_notified_at = EXCLUDED.slack_notified_at,
    stop_reason = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.stop_reason, "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State".stop_reason),
    run_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.run_id, "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State".run_id),
    updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING ghl_contact_id
),
insert_event AS (
  INSERT INTO "SimpleTexting_Campaign_Event_Log" (ghl_contact_id, campaign_key, event_type, step_number, template_key, provider_message_id, details)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $8, NULL, NULL, NULL, $9::jsonb)
)
SELECT
  TRUE AS ok,
  $9::jsonb->>'slackMessage' AS slackMessage,
  $9::jsonb->>'nextStep' AS nextStep,
  $9::jsonb->>'contactName' AS contactName,
  $9::jsonb->>'contactId' AS contactId,
  $9::jsonb->>'fromPretty' AS fromPretty,
  $9::jsonb->>'receivedAt' AS receivedAt,
  $9::jsonb->>'message' AS message,
  $9::jsonb->>'unsubscribeKeyword' AS unsubscribeKeyword;
